title: The Role of Linguistic Priors in Measuring Compositional Generalization of Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the dependency of vision-language models on linguistic priors by using pure language models to calculate the perplexity of caption candidates. The paper proposes a 'linguistic gap' metric, which measures the difference between a model's overall accuracy and its 'hard test accuracy' (performance on instances that cannot be correctly classified using language priors alone).
